caseName: Great Lakes Pipe Line Co. v. Commissioner of Taxation

attorneys: Hayner N. Larson, Erwin A. Goldstein and Leon B. Seek for appellant., Robert W. Mattson, Attorney General of Minnesota, Perry Voidness, Deputy Attorney General, and Ralph W. Peterson, Special Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.
